system.description:
As a Swift Action, you can designate a single target creature as the focus of your attentions. You gain a +2 bonus to your Speed any time you spend a Move Action to Move, provided that you end your movement adjacent to the target.

You retain this bonus (and may not use this Talent again) until your target surrenders, is reduced to 0 Hit Points, moves to the bottom of the Condition Track, or until the encounter ends.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Jedi Academy Training Manual
